title: No Margin for Error
summary:

Image reference: Tankerrr-2 (1).ξπγ.jpg | assets/2026-08-31_no-margin-for-error_img_tankerrr-228129cebecf80ceb3_89290ba50318.jpg
US refinery maintenance typically peaks in October, a season that has historically weighed on freight. This year appears different with very little currently confirmed for the autumn, as robust margins keep refiners from taking units offline. Last week, US refinery utilization clocked in at 97.4%, the highest level since 2018.
